messages:
zoe: Quick microcopy pass for the small inline tooltip that appears on the "Request again" CTA in the fallback details panel. Want it concise and clear about cost. Drafts below.

zoe: Draft A:
`Resend request (may cost extra)`

pip: Short is good. Suggest avoiding parentheses in tooltips; they can be clipped in some locales. Maybe: `Resend request — may incur additional cost`.

omar: UX: tooltips need to be accessible on focus and not only hover. Also some clients truncate long tooltips; keep < 80 chars.

sasha: Tone: "may incur additional cost" sounds formal. Could use "may incur extra cost" which is more conversational but still clear.

zoe: New option: `Resend request — may incur extra cost` (66 chars). Thoughts on including "to primary model"?

pip: Good point. In some cases request goes to the primary model; in others it retries current route. Better to avoid implying a specific target. Keep generic.

omar: Add a11y note: tooltip text should be referenced by aria-describedby on the button so screen readers can announce it when focused. Also ensure it appears on keyboard focus.

sasha: Internationalization: avoid em-dashes; use simple punctuation for translation ease. Maybe: `Resend request. May incur extra cost.`

zoe: Hmm. Periods split the message into two sentences which could be announced separately. I'd prefer a single short sentence. How about: `Resend request — may incur extra cost. (will resend input)` Too long.

pip: Keep it under 80 chars and no parenthetical notes. Final suggestion: `Resend request. May incur additional cost.` (59 chars)

omar: OK but confirm whether we prefer "additional" vs "extra". "Additional" is slightly more formal but clearer for translations.

sasha: i18n-bot: "additional" may translate more cleanly. Also provide a separate translation key for the tooltip and an alternate short key for languages with long expansions.

zoe: Final copy for spec: `Resend request. May incur additional cost.` Implementation notes:
- max length 80 chars
- tooltip available on hover and focus, aria-describedby on button
- tooltip content in translation key: `fallback.request.tooltip` with fallback English string above
- ensure tooltip is keyboard accessible and announced on focus

pip: Add test: verify tooltip appears on focus and contains exact translation key string in UI tests.

sasha: Accessibility checklist: aria-describedby, focusable, announced, tooltip persists while button focused. Color contrast for tooltip background >=4.5:1 with text.

i18n-bot: Reminder: include context comment in translation file: "Shown on hover/focus of Request again button in fallback details panel." Also provide a short fallback key if locale expansion exceeds 140 chars.

zoe: Thanks all  I'll update the docs and add the keys to the PR.
